_comment: SAMPLE / SCHEMA REFERENCE — this is the exact shape the scraper (Perplexity Computer, cron @ 07:00 PST) must write to Cloudflare R2 at feeds/external-launches.json and feeds/daily-digest.json. Upload with: node scripts/upload-feed.mjs <file> external-launches|daily-digest. Apparent reads it server-side via /api/feeds (which pulls from R2_PUBLIC_URL) and merges it into the For You feed / Daily tab. Only `name` is strictly required per launch; everything else is optional but improves the card. URLs must be absolute https:// links. This .sample.json file is documentation only and is NOT read by the app.

launches.name: Acme AI
launches.description: Acme AI automates month-end close for small accounting teams. Launched #1 Product of the Day with 1.2k upvotes.

launches.name: Brightloop
launches.description: YC W26 company building tracing and eval tooling for production agent systems.
